packet.title: Registration and evaluator seams (design, build)
packet.summary: Adds registration and evaluator seams: CMake generates function library part lists from a glob, and the reserved IR kinds dispatch through the machine's task API to stub files.

body.p: After the Phase 1 gate. Owns root CMakeLists.txt, src/processor.c (parts list only), tests/fuzz/fuzz_fixture.c, src/function_library.c (part lookup only), src/evaluator.c, src/evaluator_internal.h, new src/evaluator_machine_internal.h, stubs src/evaluator_construct.c, src/evaluator_try.c, src/evaluator_template.c, src/evaluator_global.c. CMake generates the part list from the src/function_library_*.c glob ( style); a part declares the languages it serves (XSLT-only parts, 4.10). The machine's task API (push a task, hand a value down, raise, unwind to a marked task) moves into the machine header so the reserved IR kinds (: TRY_CATCH, seven constructors, SHALLOW_COPY, APPLY_TEMPLATES) and global initializers dispatch to the four stub files, each returning UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE until Phases 3 and 4 fill them. Done when a probe part and a probe IR kind need no edit outside their own files and the slice holds. Golden: src/evaluator.c. Done 2026-10-17 (): registries generated by cmake/SxmlParts.cmake; src/function_library_parts_internal.h; part tasks and catching tasks in the machine header; probes (a part, an XSLT-only part, a catching TRY_CATCH part) verified in a private snapshot, not committed.
